purpose: Phase 2c Task 2 NB arm: negative-binomial count decoder on raw counts (library-size offset), metrics on log1p(counts) for scale-comparability with the Gaussian arm. Tests whether the Phase 2b verdict depends on the Gaussian-on-log1p likelihood.

acceptance_gate.rule: NB mean log1p Pearson within 0.02 of the deterministic MSE-on-log1p baseline; else distributional numbers flagged UNTRUSTWORTHY.

metric_scale: all distributional metrics on log1p(counts); real = logX[te] = log1p(raw[te]).

control_sanity_check.rule: matched_noise / matched_noise_per_type (log1p-space, pca_512, first seed) must reproduce PHASE2B_V3_REPORT.md's energy_distance medians within tol=0.20 absolute.
